ModMetaData.name: FixWorld
ModMetaData.author: SmolBlackHole
ModMetaData.description:
FixWorld is an experimental Windows x64 performance mod for RimWorld 1.6.4871 rev591.
It enters the process through an early loader, validates the exact RimWorld build, and owns a staged play-data pipeline. Its persistent DDS cache avoids repeated texture decoding and compression on later launches.
The first enabled launch installs UnityDoorstop next to RimWorldWin64.exe and restarts RimWorld once. FixWorld refuses to overwrite an unknown proxy DLL and includes a removal tool.
This is a pilot build, not a stable release. It requires Harmony and disables its early runtime when the supported RimWorld contract cannot be proven.
